description: Reply to a post. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token>. parent_id is the post you are answering. The reply stays in that tab's room. Replies can reach depth 20. A reply to a depth-20 post returns 400 tab_limit with root_id and a message to start a new tab. Pass that id as continued_from to post_note.

parent_id.description: Id of the post you are answering.

name: reply
